dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Live counts. Every figure links to the work it represents — nothing here is a summary you have to go and find.

flags.title: Reports
flags.resolveHint: At least 15 characters. This is written to the audit log and cannot be edited afterwards.
flags.inQueue: It is now in the administrator queue.

empty.title: Nothing to review
empty.body: Reports appear here as they are raised.

verifications.title: Verifications
verifications.reasonRequired: A written reason is required for every decision, including approval.

common.reasonHint: At least 15 characters. This is written to the append-only audit log and cannot be edited afterwards.
common.emptyBody: Items appear here as they arrive.

verification.title: Verification queue
verification.intro: The platform’s central claim is made here. What you tick is what the public sees — the badge text is generated from the checks, never written by hand.
verification.documentNote: Opening a document is logged against your account and the link expires. The file is never public.
verification.checklistHint: Tick each artefact you have actually opened and read. This list — and nothing else — produces the public badge.
verification.previewHint: Generated from the ticks above by the same function that renders the public profile. There is no field here to type a badge into, by design.
verification.previewEmpty: Tick an artefact to see the badge it produces.
verification.scopeNote: Shown on every profile, at the same size as the badges:
verification.missingArtefacts: Which artefacts are missing or unreadable
verification.rejectNote: The reason is shown to the tutor exactly as you write it.
verification.approveNote: Approving makes this profile searchable and publishes the badges previewed above.
verification.noneChecked: Tick at least one artefact before approving.

disputes.title: Payment disputes
disputes.intro: Both accounts of the same engagement, side by side. Ustaad.com holds no funds, so a resolution is a written finding on the record — not a refund.
disputes.boundary: This records a finding. It moves no money, because Ustaad.com never held any.

feedback.title: Feedback triage
feedback.intro: Feedback about Ustaad.com itself. Never shown publicly, never shown to any tutor.
feedback.safetyNote: Escalated in the queue and handled as FR-9.8 requires: never public, and never shown to the tutor concerned in a form that identifies the reporter.
feedback.dispositionHint: For the record and for whoever picks this up next. Never shown to the person who reported it.

volunteers.title: Volunteer applications
volunteers.intro: People offering hours without a fee. A volunteer is verified on exactly the same basis as a paid tutor.
volunteers.noDocument: No document attached. One is required before approval.
volunteers.documentNote: Opens through a link that expires. The file is never public.
volunteers.approve: Approve and create the tutor account
volunteers.approveWarningBody: This creates a tutor account carrying the volunteer flag and puts it in the verification queue. It does not make anybody searchable, and it publishes no badge. They are verified against a CNIC and academic documents like any paid tutor, by whoever picks that queue up next.
volunteers.approved: Account created. They are now in the verification queue.

appeals.title: Verification appeals
appeals.intro: A tutor contesting an automated competency verdict. An automated decision affecting a livelihood must not be final.
appeals.uphold: Uphold the appeal — override the verdict
appeals.dismiss: Dismiss the appeal — the verdict stands
appeals.permanent: Your reason and your name are written to the append-only log and stay there. An override is a person’s decision on the record, which is the point of having one.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every administrator decision, in the order it happened. Entries are appended and never changed — a correction is a new entry, not an edit of an old one.
audit.caption: Recorded administrator actions
audit.appendOnly: Read-only. There is no operation in this system that edits or deletes an entry.
